draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 134th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 16th of 28 at WR. He went 105th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (134th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Demarcus Robinson. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (92nd percentile). Testing concerns: 10-yard split (16th percentile), vertical jump (19th percentile). College production: 803 receiving yards in 2021, 20th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 13 career games and 0 starts over 1 completed season. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2022. Weak spots: receiving yards 10 (4th percentile), approximate value 0 (5th percentile).
